sections.heading: 1. Information Collection
sections.text: We collect information when you register on our site, make a donation, subscribe to our newsletter, or fill out a form.

sections.heading: 2. Use of Information
sections.text: The information we collect may be used to personalize your experience, improve our website, enhance service to members, and contact you by email.

sections.heading: 3. Protection of Information
sections.text: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information.

sections.heading: 4. Disclosure to Third Parties
sections.text: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer your personally identifiable information to third parties.

sections.heading: 5. Consent
sections.text: By using our site, you consent to our privacy policy.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Our website uses cookies to improve your browsing experience. Cookies are small text files stored on your device.

types.label: Necessary Cookies
